faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Clear answers to common client questions about execution, scope, and support.

items.question: How do you approach a new project?
items.answer: We start with discovery and measurable goals, then prototype and validate before full implementation.

items.question: What is your experience with AI systems in production?
items.answer: We build multi-tier systems with guardrails, validation layers, fallback paths, and practical observability.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We monitor results, iterate based on real usage, and optimize continuously after launch.

items.question: How do you handle ambitious scope?
items.answer: We phase delivery deliberately: MVP first, then expansion, with explicit tradeoffs and milestones.

items.question: What if the project needs a bigger team?
items.answer: We can lead delivery directly or integrate with your existing team and specialists as needed.

items.question: How do you price projects?
items.answer: Pricing depends on scope and complexity. We use clear milestones and transparent execution plans.
